briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 push frontier amid escalating US-China AI tensions

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate releases as compute scaling continues. Regulatory scrutiny intensifies globally while investment remains robust. Prompt injection and multi-agent risks dominate security discussions.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with enhanced reasoning; xAI launches Grok-4; Google DeepMind releases Gemini 3; Meta open-sources Llama 4; DeepSeek unveils R2. Competition for AGI leadership intensifies.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins with new fines.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates; Microsoft and Google announce new 100k H100 clusters; TSMC reports AI chip demand surge. Energy constraints emerge in key data center regions.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent security protocols like DialectForge become mandatory for all frontier deployments by 2027?
